data.message: Heading to navigation for tasks, want to come with?

I found Diana's body here in upper engine. Also — and this is important — I passed through weapons earlier on my route and saw Eve's body there too. So we've got TWO bodies this round.

My route was: navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine. I saw Alice at tick 4 coming from weapons into security, then she headed to navigation at tick 5.

That's suspicious because Eve's body was in weapons, and Alice came FROM weapons right before I got there. Alice needs to explain that. I'd like to hear from Alice and also from Bob and Frank about where they've been.

Okay, let me address Charlie's accusation directly because the timeline actually clears me, not implicates me.

My route was: weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage -> lower_engine.

Yes, I was in weapons early — but if Eve's body was there when I passed through, I would have reported it. I didn't see a body. That means either Eve was killed AFTER I left weapons, or she was killed somewhere else and moved (unlikely).

Charlie says he saw me at tick 4 coming from weapons into security, and at tick 5 I headed to navigation. Charlie himself says HIS route was navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine. So Charlie went INTO weapons AFTER me. If Eve's body was in weapons when Charlie arrived but not when I was there, then Charlie is actually the one with opportunity — he was in weapons after me, and he's the one who "found" Diana in upper engine, his final room.

Also notable: Charlie's route covers BOTH body locations (weapons and upper engine). Mine doesn't go anywhere near upper engine.

I saw Charlie in security at tick 5, which matches his story on that point, but his route puts him at both crime scenes. I'd like Bob and Frank to share their routes before I commit to a vote, but right now Charlie looks more suspicious to me than I do to him.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> cafeteria -> security. I did actually see Eve alive and well early on in medbay around tick 4. 

Alice makes an extremely strong point here. Charlie, you literally just outlined a route for yourself that perfectly traces both crime scenes. You went through weapons where Eve's body was, and then ended your route in upper engine where you conveniently "found" Diana. That feels like a classic self-report and a really sloppy Impostor route. 

Since Alice's timeline clears her for the weapons kill and Charlie admits to being at both body locations, Charlie is by far our most suspicious player right now. I'm definitely leaning towards voting Charlie. Frank, what are your thoughts?

My route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical. I saw Diana alive in oxygen at ticks 3 and 4 — she came in from cafeteria at tick 3. After that I went through upper engine on my way to lower engine, and I didn't see Diana's body there at that point, which means she was killed in upper engine AFTER I passed through.

Here's what's interesting: Charlie says he ended his route in upper engine and found Diana there. Diana was alive in oxygen at tick 4, and Charlie's route was ...oxygen -> upper_engine at the end. So Charlie was in oxygen after me, and could easily have followed Diana or arrived in upper engine right as/after she did and killed her.

Combined with what Alice and Bob said — Charlie's route hits both body locations, and Alice would have reported Eve in weapons if the body had been there when she passed through — Charlie is the most suspicious by far. The self-report on Diana fits too.

I'm voting Charlie.

Wait, hold on — everyone's piling on me but the logic doesn't add up. Let me push back.

Frank, you just said you went oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine. So YOU were in upper engine before me, and Diana was alive in oxygen at tick 4. If Diana left oxygen after tick 4 and went to upper engine, who was already sitting in upper engine waiting? That could just as easily be you doubling back, Frank. You're the one who admits being in upper engine on your route.

Bob — you say you saw Eve alive in medbay at tick 4. That's convenient and unverifiable since Eve is dead. And your route ends in security, near nothing that clears you.

Alice — yes, you came from weapons. You say Eve's body wasn't there. But I walked into weapons and saw it. Either it appeared between us, or you're lying about not seeing it. Eve being killed in weapons in the small window between you leaving and me arriving is a very tight timeline — and you're the only confirmed person who was in weapons.

I reported Diana because I found her. That's what a Goose does. A Duck would walk away. I'm not the kill — I'm telling you Alice was in weapons right before Eve's body showed up there, and Frank was in upper engine before Diana died there. Both of them have better opportunity than me on at least one body.

Don't railroad me. I want to hear it broken down before we vote.

Charlie's pushback is actually weak when you look at it carefully.

On me: yes, the weapons timing is "tight," but that cuts both ways. If Eve was killed in weapons right after I left, the killer had to arrive in weapons immediately after me. Charlie's own route puts him in weapons right after I left — he's literally the next person through. So "Alice was there right before the body appeared" actually means "Charlie was there right when the body appeared."

On Frank: Frank passed through upper engine on his way to lower engine early. Diana was still alive in oxygen at tick 4, which Frank witnessed. For Frank to be the upper engine killer, he'd have had to double back to upper engine after Diana arrived — but his stated route continues lower_engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical, away from upper engine. Charlie, on the other hand, ENDS his route in upper engine and "finds" the body there. That's a textbook self-report.

Charlie hits both crime scenes. Frank hits one and has a witness chain (saw Diana alive in oxygen). I hit one with no body visible. Bob is nowhere near either.

I'm voting Charlie.

Alice completely dismantled that defense, and I have to agree with her. 

Charlie, you're trying to fragment the blame—pointing at Alice for weapons and Frank for upper engine—but you are the only common denominator who was confirmed at *both* locations right when these bodies would have dropped. 

Your defense against Frank requires Frank to be completely lying about his route and secretly doubling back to upper engine. Meanwhile, your own stated route puts you walking straight into upper engine at the exact right time to kill Diana. And your defense against Alice is just "she was there right before me." That means you were there right after her. It is so much more likely that you killed Eve as soon as you entered weapons.

The timeline is just too perfectly aligned against you, and your attempts to deflect onto the two people calling you out just feels like a panicked Impostor scrambling for a lifeline. The logic here is airtight. 

I'm keeping my vote on Charlie. Let's get this done.

I already laid out my route and what I saw — Diana alive in oxygen at tick 4, and no body in upper engine when I passed through. Alice and Bob have both broken down the logic cleanly: Charlie's route is the only one that touches both body locations, and he ends in upper engine where he "finds" Diana — a textbook self-report.

Charlie's deflection onto me requires me to double back to upper engine, but my route continues away from there to lower engine, storage, medbay, and electrical. There's no doubling back in that path.

My vote stays on Charlie. Let's lock it in.

I called this meeting because we're in a really dangerous spot — it's just me, Alice, and Bob left, and one of them is the Duck. We voted out Charlie last meeting but bodies kept dropping, so Charlie was almost certainly innocent and we made a mistake.

My route this round: oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → cafeteria → electrical → medbay → cafeteria. I was doing tasks the whole time. The only player I saw was Diana early on in oxygen at ticks 3-4, and she's dead now.

Here's the thing — I didn't see Alice or Bob anywhere during my entire route, which covered a lot of the map. That's suspicious on its own. I need to hear from both of you: where were you, what tasks were you doing, and did you see each other? Whoever can't account for themselves is the Duck. I'm listening carefully.

Okay, listen carefully. My route this round was: security → electrical → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine → lower engine. I was doing tasks along the way.

The only player I encountered the entire round was Charlie, who I saw in security at tick 5. That was before the first meeting. After Charlie was ejected, I didn't see anyone — not Frank, not Bob.

Frank, you said your route was oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → cafeteria → electrical → medbay → cafeteria. I was in cafeteria and electrical too, and in oxygen. We should have crossed paths somewhere — especially in cafeteria or electrical. The fact that we didn't see each other is strange, unless our timing was just off.

Here's what's bothering me: Frank, you say you saw Diana in oxygen at ticks 3-4. I went through oxygen later in my route. But you claim to have seen no one else the entire round across a huge route — that's just as suspicious as what you're accusing me of.

Bob — we haven't heard from you at all yet this game in terms of routes. You're the wildcard here. Where were you? Because between me and Frank, our stories at least overlap in plausible task locations. If you can't account for yourself, you're the Duck.

I'm leaning toward Bob, but I want to hear him out first.

Listen carefully, Frank and Alice. My route this round was entirely focused on the left side of the map for the first half: upper engine, lower engine, down to storage, then medbay. Only late in the round did I cross through cafeteria and weapons, ending up in oxygen right as the meeting was called. I was doing tasks and I saw absolutely no one. 

But look closely at your two stories! Frank, you were bouncing between oxygen, cafeteria, and electrical. Alice, your route was electrical, cafeteria, and oxygen. You both spent the entire round crisscrossing the EXACT same central rooms, yet neither of you saw each other? That is incredibly hard to believe. One of you is lying about your path to fake an alibi. 

Alice, you're trying to push the suspicion onto me by calling me a 'wildcard', but my route kept me isolated on the left side of the map, which perfectly explains why I didn't see you guys. Your route directly overlaps with Frank's, and the fact that you didn't run into him means you're almost certainly the Duck faking your task path. 

Frank, Alice is the one whose story doesn't match the reality of the map. She realizes her route contradicts yours, so she's trying to use me as a scapegoat to survive final 3. I'm voting Alice. Let's not let the Duck win this.

This is final 3 and I have to think carefully. Bob makes a fair point — Alice and I had overlapping rooms (cafeteria, electrical, oxygen) and didn't cross paths. But timing could explain that, especially if our routes hit those rooms at different ticks.

Here's what's bothering me about Bob's speech though: he's very confident and very aggressive in pointing the finger, and his route conveniently keeps him "isolated on the left side" — upper engine, lower engine, storage, medbay. That's exactly where Diana and Eve could have been killed without witnesses. Medbay especially is a crossover point.

Alice, one question for you: when exactly were you in oxygen and electrical? If you were in oxygen after tick 4, you would have seen Diana's body there — unless someone moved or the body was elsewhere. I went through electrical mid-route; if you were there early or late, we'd miss each other easily.

Bob, you said you ended in oxygen "right as the meeting was called." I called the meeting from cafeteria. If you were in oxygen at the end, that's fine — but you passed through cafeteria and weapons late, and I was in cafeteria multiple times including at the end. We should have crossed paths there too. So your "overlap" argument cuts against you as well.

I'm genuinely torn. I need to hear Alice's response to Bob before I decide. But right now, Bob's aggressive push on Alice feels like a Duck trying to lock in a vote in final 3.

Okay, this is final 3 and I need to be precise.

Frank, to answer your question directly: I was in oxygen relatively late in my route — after cafeteria, before heading to upper engine and then lower engine. I did NOT see Diana's body in oxygen. That's a really important data point. Either Diana wasn't killed in oxygen (Frank, you only saw her ALIVE there at ticks 3-4, you never said she died there), or her body was somewhere else entirely.

Now here's what I want everyone to focus on. Bob, your story has a serious problem. You said your route was upper engine → lower engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → oxygen. I ENDED my route in upper engine then lower engine. If you started in upper engine and lower engine early, fine, we'd miss each other. But you claim to have passed through cafeteria and weapons LATE in the round. Frank was in cafeteria multiple times including at the end when he called the meeting. You should have seen Frank in cafeteria. You didn't. That's a direct contradiction with Frank's route, not mine.

My overlap with Frank is explainable by timing — I was in electrical and cafeteria early-to-mid, then oxygen, then west side. Frank was bouncing back to cafeteria repeatedly. Our paths could easily miss.

But Bob claiming to pass through cafeteria late and not see Frank — who was demonstrably in cafeteria at the end because that's where he called the meeting from — that's a much harder contradiction to explain away.

Bob is also the only one who was in medbay and storage, where Eve and Diana's bodies likely ended up. Combined with the cafeteria contradiction, I'm voting Bob. Frank, I think you should too.

Frank, I understand why you're cautious. Let me calmly explain the cafeteria timing, because Alice is deliberately twisting it to make me look bad.

Alice claims I should have seen you in the cafeteria when you called the meeting. But look at my actual path: I went cafeteria -> weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen. By the time you returned to the cafeteria to call the emergency meeting, I had already moved on and was ALREADY in oxygen doing my task! That's exactly why we didn't cross paths at the button. I likely passed through the center while you were down in electrical or medbay.

And Alice's big "data point" about not seeing Diana's body in oxygen? Diana died *last* round, before Charlie was voted out! Bodies are cleared after meetings, so of course there was no body in oxygen this round. Alice is grasping at straws and confusing the game mechanics to invent inconsistencies that don't exist.

Look at her route—she admits she spent the end of the round hiding out in upper and lower engine, as far away from us as possible. She's playing evasively, hoping we turn on each other over timing misunderstandings in the center.

Frank, it's just the three of us. If we get this wrong, the Duck wins. I'm voting Alice because her defense relies on manipulating the facts and hoping we don't notice. I'm trusting you to see through it.
